GREEN (per file): c09 13/2todo, c10 12/1, c11 11/0, c14 19/2, c16 12/5, adr-12 13/1, c17 16/3, c18 13/4, c20 13/3, c22 11/3, c24 16/3, git-transport 15/0, exchange-status 11/0, admission-trust 7/0. tsc clean (only the pre-existing gitignored _generated-posthog-key).

DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED (all were live, none were test gaps):
D1 projection lost admitted events when their FILES vanished — admittedEnvelopes() re-read every event from disk, so a shallow/sparse checkout or reset --hard silently dropped records at the next project(). Journal now caches the exact stored bytes (schema v2 + ALTER) and falls back to them; checkout_behind_journal is reported separately.
D2 carriers SWALLOWED malformed artifacts — FsTransport.readIfPresent returned null on truncated/conflicted bytes, so C17's retained-with-a-reason requirement was unfalsifiable. Carriers now surface `lastMalformed`; the store retains them in an ingest_attempts ledger keyed on the sha256 of the observed bytes.
D3 dedup keyed on a SELF-DECLARED digest — garbage claiming a real event's id+digest suppressed delivery of the genuine event. receive() now verifies the declared digest against the bytes first (digest_mismatch, retained); two slice tests that were asserting the weaker classification were corrected.
D4 cycle detection was per-PASS — three prerequisite edges delivered in one batch all admitted because each was judged against a view frozen at the start of the pass. Cycle check now sees events admitted earlier in the same pass. Also extended from supersession-only to prerequisite relations (requires/depends_on) and decision.depends_on, which is what C22's cycle is actually built from.
D5 an imported human principal minted a ruling signer (the C12 hole the slice bootstrapped around). humanKeys is now the fixpoint closure over the bootstrapped set: trusted only if bootstrapped out of band or introduced by an event SIGNED by an already-trusted human key. Unsigned/agent-signed human principals stay admissible as data; a ruling by such a key is quarantined signer_unknown (retryable), never rejected terminally.
D6 nothing bound the SIGNING KEY to the asserted producer — an agent could sign with its own key and claim to be someone else. New author_assertion_not_authenticated rejection, recorded as its OWN reason beside any scope denial (C24 C-5 requires both).
D7 deferral trail went stale — settle() did not treat a shrinking pending_on set as a change, so the admission log kept the first, wrongest list of missing prerequisites.

LEAD RULING IMPLEMENTED: capability is now judged against the membership projected from the event's CAUSAL ANCESTORS (ancestorMembership walk over parents), at first admission and on rebuild. Tests: a membership added after admission no longer drops the event on rebuild (acknowledged_events_lost 0), and forward/reverse delivery orders produce identical projection digests before and after rebuild. No-policy-in-ancestry stays quarantined (retryable); a policy in ancestry that denies stays terminal. Note on `superseded.by` becoming optional: no change needed, addSupersessionEdge and relationEndpoints already guard on typeof === "string".

PROPOSED src/contracts DIFFS (not applied):
1. delivery.ts QUARANTINE_REASONS += "signer_untrusted" (currently reusing signer_unknown for a resolvable-but-untrusted human key; the two are different facts).
2. delivery.ts REJECT_REASONS += "credential_revoked", "author_assertion_not_authenticated", "digest_mismatch" is present but the first two are emitted as free strings today.
3. validate.ts ValidationCode += "CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE" as a real member (the slice's cast is still the only place the gap shows).
4. store-api.ts: add `exchangeStatus(opts?)` to the EventStore interface and export the ExchangeStatus shape, so lanes 03/04 can type against it.
5. store-api.ts Transport: optional `lastMalformed` / `lastGap` so the C17/C14 surfaces are contractual rather than duck-typed.

GIT TOPOLOGY: orphan branch refs/heads/twining/exchange built by plumbing (mktree empty → commit-tree → update-ref → worktree add), checked out at <store>/exchange/. publish writes a file once and never rewrites it (a conflicting digest goes to conflicts/<id>.<digest12>.json), stages only those paths, commits, fetches, merges with --allow-unrelated-histories, and VERIFIES the union (every (path,oid) on both sides present afterwards) rather than trusting git. carrier id = commit sha. poll rescans on an unreachable cursor and reports lastGap on BOTH sides (local head rewound; remote head force-pushed under us). ack writes cursors/<principal>.json, stages only it. Source-branch mode exists, is labeled, and its forfeit of non-interference is asserted (the working tree changes).
UNSUPPORTED: no shallow-clone exchange worktree; no per-consumer fan-out (one carrier, many consumers is not modeled, so C20 C1's per-destination booleans are a todo); the in-process relay cannot cross a process boundary so the C18 fault suite runs over fs: and git: only, with that stated.</detail>
